theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 59 群

items.pos: n. 地面 | v. 使停飛
items.colloc: on the ground 在現場 | break new ground 有創新突破
items.distinct: floor 室內地板 | field 田野或專業領域
ex: The plane was grounded due to the storm.
因暴風雨影響，該班機被迫停飛。
Our company is breaking new ground in AI.
我們公司在人工智慧領域有創新突破。
All field staff must report on the ground.
所有外勤人員必須在現場回報狀況。

items.colloc: ideally suited 非常適合 | ideally located 地點極佳
items.distinct: perfectly 完美地 | typically 通常地
ex: Ideally, the report should be finished today.
原則上，這份報告應該今天完成。
This location is ideally suited for a store.
這個地點非常適合開設店面。
The office is ideally located near the station.
該辦公室地點極佳，鄰近車站。

items.colloc: prevent infection 防止感染 | severe infection 嚴重感染
items.distinct: inflammation 發炎 | contamination 污染
ex: Proper hygiene can help prevent infection.
保持良好衛生習慣有助於預防感染。
The patient is being treated for an infection.
該病患目前正在接受感染治療。
Wash your hands to avoid potential infection.
請洗手以避免可能的感染風險。

items.colloc: instead of 代替 | just instead 剛好相反
items.distinct: rather 相反地 | alternatively 或者
ex: We decided to buy the laptop instead.
我們決定改買那台筆記型電腦。
They chose digital marketing instead of print.
他們選擇數位行銷而非印刷廣告。
She didn't quit, but instead worked harder.
她沒有離職，反而更加努力工作。

items.colloc: justify the cost 證明成本合理 | fully justified 完全有理
items.distinct: verify 核實 | validate 驗證
ex: Can you justify the increase in expenses?
你能解釋費用增加的合理性嗎？
The results justify our investment strategy.
這些結果證明了我們的投資策略是正確的。
He tried to justify his late arrival today.
他試圖為今天的遲到找理由辯解。

items.colloc: lately improved 最近改善 | seen lately 近期看過
items.distinct: late 遲到的 | recently 最近的
ex: Have you been to the new office lately?
你最近有去過那間新辦公室嗎？
Business has been quite slow lately.
最近業務量相當冷清。
We have lately observed a rise in sales.
我們近來觀察到銷售額有成長趨勢。

items.colloc: massive scale 大規模 | massive effort 巨大的努力
items.distinct: huge 巨大的 | wide 寬廣的
ex: The company made a massive investment in R&D.
公司在研發上投入了巨額資金。
We are planning a massive marketing campaign.
我們正在策劃一場大規模的行銷活動。
There was a massive crowd at the expo.
展覽會現場擠滿了大量人潮。

items.colloc: namely the following 也就是下列事項 | namely because 主要是因為
items.distinct: specifically 特別是 | in other words 換句話說
ex: Only one person, namely the manager, knows.
只有一個人，也就是經理本人知道。
We have one main goal, namely to grow.
我們有一個主要目標，即追求成長。
There is one problem, namely the budget.
目前有一個問題，也就是預算不足。

items.colloc: ordering system 訂購系統 | online ordering 線上訂購
items.distinct: order 順序 | command 命令
ex: The ordering process is quite user-friendly.
這個訂購流程相當人性化。
We are improving our online ordering system.
我們正在改良線上訂購系統。
Please check the alphabetical ordering of names.
請檢查名稱的字母排序是否正確。

items.colloc: shipping port 貨運港口 | port authority 港務局
items.distinct: harbor 避風港 | dock 碼頭
ex: The goods arrived at the local port yesterday.
貨物昨日已抵達當地港口。
This laptop has a new charging port design.
這款筆電有新型的充電埠設計。
The port will be closed for maintenance soon.
該港口即將關閉進行維修作業。

items.colloc: possess skills 具備技能 | fully possess 完全擁有
items.distinct: own 擁有權 | contain 包含
ex: Candidates must possess a master's degree.
候選人必須具備碩士學位。
She possesses strong leadership qualities.
她具備卓越的領導特質。
Do you possess the necessary software tools?
你有具備必要的軟體工具嗎？

items.colloc: presumably true 大概是真的 | presumably correct 據推測正確
items.distinct: probably 可能地 | possibly 可能地
ex: Presumably, the meeting will start on time.
據推測，會議將會準時開始。
He is presumably working in the office today.
他大概今天在辦公室工作。
The results are presumably available by noon.
結果大概中午前會出來。

items.colloc: projected growth 預計成長 | projected sales 預估銷售
items.distinct: predicted 預測的 | expected 期待的
ex: The projected revenue is higher than last year.
預計收入比去年更高。
We exceeded the projected sales targets.
我們超越了預估的銷售目標。
The projected timeline seems too ambitious.
這個預計的時間表似乎過於理想化。

items.colloc: high proportion 高比例 | large proportion 大部分
items.distinct: percentage 百分比 | ratio 比率
ex: A large proportion of staff prefer working remotely.
很大比例的員工偏好遠端工作。
The proportion of expenses is getting higher.
支出的比例正逐漸升高。
Budget allocation is out of proportion here.
這裡的預算配置比例失衡。

items.pos: conj. 假如；只要 | v. 提供(過去式)
items.colloc: provided that 只要… | provided services 所提供的服務
items.distinct: suppose 假設 | assuming 假設
ex: We can finish, provided that we get help.
只要獲得協助，我們就能完成任務。
The company provided excellent training sessions.
公司提供了很棒的培訓課程。
Provided it rains, we move the event inside.
假如遇到下雨，我們就將活動移至室內。

items.colloc: bad publicity 負面報導 | publicity campaign 宣傳活動
items.distinct: advertising 廣告 | fame 名聲
ex: The product received a lot of positive publicity.
該產品獲得了許多正面宣傳。
They are launching a new publicity campaign.
他們正在發起一項新的宣傳活動。
We need more publicity to attract clients.
我們需要更多宣傳來吸引客戶。

items.colloc: quietly confident 默默地自信 | work quietly 安靜工作
items.distinct: silently 靜默地 | calm 平靜地
ex: She worked quietly at her desk all day.
她整天安靜地在位子上工作。
The market is quietly recovering this month.
市場本月正悄悄地復甦。
He is quietly confident about the presentation.
他對簡報表現出沈穩的自信。

items.colloc: quite good 相當好 | quite difficult 相當困難
items.distinct: quiet 安靜的 | rather 頗為
ex: The office is quite busy this morning.
辦公室今天早上相當忙碌。
We have quite a lot of work today.
我們今天有相當多的工作量。
That task was quite challenging for us.
那項任務對我們而言相當具挑戰性。

items.colloc: raised concerns 提出疑慮 | raised capital 募集資金
items.distinct: rose 上升(不及物) | lift 舉起
ex: Management raised the salary for all staff.
管理層提高了全體員工的薪資。
Several members raised questions during the meeting.
幾位成員在會議中提出了問題。
We raised enough capital for the expansion.
我們為擴張計畫募集了足夠的資金。

items.colloc: widely recognized 廣受認可 | recognized brand 知名的品牌
items.distinct: known 知名的 | admitted 承認
ex: The company is recognized for its quality.
該公司因其品質而受到認可。
He finally recognized his mistake in the report.
他終於承認了報告中的錯誤。
This certificate is recognized internationally.
這份證書是受到國際認可的。
